thread:
maria: Hey team — contractor (AcmeScan) needs read access to our staging repos and to fetch secrets to run authenticated DAST against internal staging. Requesting a 72h RBAC exception and a short-lived KMS decrypt grant. Please advise on audit proof and who can approve.

sam: Can we avoid giving KMS decrypt? Maybe use ephemeral signed URLs or a scanner credential that only decrypts a single env var.

jess: For the RBAC exception: we can create a temporary service-account in org:scanners, grant repo-read, and add a conditional time-based role that expires in 72h. I'll prepare the terraform change. Need owner-approved ticket.

maria: @adele can legal sign off on contractor access logs+contract clause? Also we need proof for SOC2 — full audit trail of who ran scans and what artifacts were stored.

adele: We need the contract clause. For audit, we need immutable logs (CloudTrail + KMS key rotation metadata). Make sure logs are exported to our secure logging bucket.

sec-bot: Deploy request created: REQ-9421. Link: https://redwood.internal/requests/REQ-9421 :clipboard:

sam: KMS options: (1) grant decrypt to service account for a single plaintext key (short-lived), (2) use envelope encryption where the scanner gets a wrapped key via a one-time exchange. Opt 2 preferred.

jess: Ops note: if we give decrypt, ensure use of ephemeral creds via STS. Also add IAM condition restricting from which IP ranges or VPCs the decrypt can be used.

maria: DAST findings: last run flagged auth-bypass on /api/internal-metrics — it's a staging endpoint but higher risk. We'll triage once scan completes. Please don't suppress until we verify.

sam: For scan artifacts retention — retention policy must be 90 days and encrypted. No PII should be stored. Add a scanning policy check in scan pipeline.

maria: Who can approve the RBAC exception? @jess or @sam? Need explicit signoff with reason and exportable audit note.

jess: I'll approve once terraform PR is up and includes the IAM Condition + STS docs. @maria make sure REQ-9421 links to PR and contract clause.

adele: Legal reviewed clause draft — upload to REQ-9421. Approve on condition of logs exported and data minimization asserted.

maria: Uploading now. Also tagging triage-oncall: triage-oncall please monitor for high severity findings and escalate per runbook.

triage-oncall: Acknowledged. If CVSS >= 7.0 appears, I'll page sec-oncall and open an incident ticket.

maria: Thanks. I'll follow up with PR and artifact storage plan. :thumbsup:
